headline: ShelfMitra's Kolkata office and Bengali beta make it the top threat this week
tl_dr: ShelfMitra opened a Kolkata office for West Bengal retailers [ShelfMitra-3-3] and added Bengali beta support [ShelfMitra-3-2]; its 15 Kolkata sales roles remain open [ShelfMitra-3-6][ShelfMitra-3-7][ShelfMitra-3-8].
BahiBook opened a new Pune role for Product Manager, GST e-invoicing [BahiBook-3-1], signalling a move toward GST e-invoicing.
StockSathi's app-store rating fell from 4.3 to 3.9 on 18,665 reviews, with the top complaint now duplicate UPI Udhaar reminders [StockSathi-3-4]; a fix shipped 2026-10-21 [StockSathi-3-2].
Pricing is unchanged at all three competitors: StockSathi [StockSathi-3-1], ShelfMitra [ShelfMitra-3-1], BahiBook [BahiBook-3-4].
since_last_week: Threat levels moved: StockSathi from high to low, BahiBook from low to medium, and ShelfMitra stayed high [StockSathi-3-4][StockSathi-3-2][BahiBook-3-1][ShelfMitra-3-3].
New: ShelfMitra added Bengali beta support on 2026-10-20 [ShelfMitra-3-2] and opened a Kolkata office [ShelfMitra-3-3].
New: BahiBook opened a GST e-invoicing Product Manager role in Pune [BahiBook-3-1] and fixed Devanagari ledger search on 2026-10-22 [BahiBook-3-3].
New: StockSathi shipped a fix stopping duplicate UPI Udhaar reminders, dated 2026-10-21 [StockSathi-3-2], after its app-store rating dropped from 4.3 to 3.9 [StockSathi-3-4].

Unchanged: all pricing [StockSathi-3-1][ShelfMitra-3-1][BahiBook-3-4]; StockSathi careers page [StockSathi-3-3]; ShelfMitra's Mumbai and Kolkata roles [ShelfMitra-3-4][ShelfMitra-3-5][ShelfMitra-3-6][ShelfMitra-3-7][ShelfMitra-3-8]; BahiBook's Pune Customer Support role [BahiBook-3-2].

threats.rationale: Shipped Bengali beta support [ShelfMitra-3-2] and a newly opened Kolkata office serving West Bengal retailers [ShelfMitra-3-3] are launch evidence of a credible move into KiranaCloud's home market. The standing Kolkata sales build-out of 12 Field Sales Executives, 2 Territory Sales Managers and a Regional Sales Head [ShelfMitra-3-6][ShelfMitra-3-7][ShelfMitra-3-8] supports the rating but does not justify it on its own.

A single new open role for Product Manager, GST e-invoicing in Pune [BahiBook-3-1] signals intent, but nothing has shipped yet, so it is rated medium. The Devanagari ledger search fix [BahiBook-3-3] and unchanged pricing [BahiBook-3-4] add no further threat.

The app-store rating drop to 3.9 [StockSathi-3-4] comes from a UPI Udhaar reminder bug that StockSathi has already patched [StockSathi-3-2]. Pricing and hiring are unchanged [StockSathi-3-1][StockSathi-3-3].

recommendations.action: Assign named reps from the Kolkata team to the accounts most exposed to ShelfMitra's new office, starting with West Bengal retailers.
Scope our response to BahiBook's GST e-invoicing hiring by confirming our e-invoicing roadmap date.
If the duplicate-reminder fix holds, prepare a switching message for StockSathi users frustrated by duplicate UPI Udhaar reminders.

watchlist: ShelfMitra-3-2: Bengali support is beta only; watch for general availability.
StockSathi-3-6: blog-reported Mysuru feedback meetup with around 80 store owners (credibility 0.6); a possible early sign of a feedback-led push.
discounted_claims: StockSathi-3-5: unverified Startup Gupshup blog claim (credibility 0.2) that a large e-commerce player is acquiring StockSathi; no company has confirmed it.
